answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the juniper of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Work waits on the haven until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the fable of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on receipt hashes checked against public logs before trust.
